name: SkyeMusicNexus Open Source Creation Stack
purpose: Use open-source DAW/audio projects as external engines beneath the existing SkyeMusicNexus platform rooms.

engines.name: openDAW
engines.integration: Run/build externally, then mount into public/create.html through iframe bridge.

engines.name: Ardour
engines.integration: Desktop workflow; import/export stems and masters into SkyeMusicNexus.

engines.name: LMMS
engines.integration: Desktop workflow; export bounces, stems, MIDI, and sample packs.

engines.name: Audacity
engines.role: waveform editing, cleanup, trimming, and vocal prep
engines.integration: Desktop workflow; export cleaned audio into gated upload/stem lane.

licenseBoundary: Do not claim third-party code as Skies/SOL-owned.
If modifying/distributing AGPL/GPL engines, preserve source availability obligations.
Keep platform business logic separate from vendor engine source where possible.
